code.r:
edges = trips %>%
  filter(rush %in% c("am", "pm")) %>%
  count(from, to, wt = count, name = "weight") %>%
  filter(weight >= 1)

g = graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)
# tidygraph: tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, node_key = "code", directed = TRUE)
adj = as_adjacency_matrix(g, attr = "weight", sparse = FALSE)

tibble(tally_rows = nrow(filter(trips, rush %in% c("am", "pm"))),
       trips = sum(edges$weight), edges = gsize(g), nodes = gorder(g),
       cells_filled = sum(adj > 0), cells_total = length(adj),
       matrix_bytes = 8 * length(adj), edgelist_bytes = 8 * 3 * gsize(g))
code.sql:
SELECT start_code AS "from", end_code AS "to", SUM(count) AS weight
FROM tally_rush_edges
WHERE day BETWEEN '2021-07-01' AND '2021-07-31'
  AND rush IN ('am', 'pm')
  AND start_code IN (SELECT code FROM nodes)
  AND end_code IN (SELECT code FROM nodes)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(count) >= 1;

code.r:
edges = trips %>%
  filter(rush %in% c("am", "pm")) %>%
  mutate(a = pmin(from, to), b = pmax(from, to), from = a, to = b) %>%
  count(from, to, wt = count, name = "weight") %>%
  filter(weight >= 1)

g = graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = nodes)
# tidygraph: tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, node_key = "code", directed = FALSE)
adj = as_adjacency_matrix(g, attr = "weight", sparse = FALSE)

tibble(tally_rows = nrow(filter(trips, rush %in% c("am", "pm"))),
       trips = sum(edges$weight), edges = gsize(g), nodes = gorder(g),
       cells_filled = sum(adj > 0), cells_total = length(adj),
       matrix_bytes = 8 * length(adj), edgelist_bytes = 8 * 3 * gsize(g))
